title: The Lost Ring
scene: At 6:30 PM, a gold ring vanished from the pool bench. The pool was drained for cleaning from 6:00 to 7:00.

suspects.name: Pia Sato
suspects.testimony: I was at the empty pool edge at 6:30, checking the ladder.
suspects.alibiProof: The ladder camera shows Pia at 6:28 and 6:34.

suspects.name: Milo Reed
suspects.testimony: I was swimming laps in the empty pool at 6:30.
suspects.contradiction: The pool had no water at 6:30, and the ring was in Milo's swim bag.

suspects.name: Tessa Vale
suspects.testimony: I was scrubbing tiles in the changing room at 6:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The changing room log shows Tessa's badge at 6:27.

suspects.name: Owen Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the front gate at 6:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The gate camera shows Owen at 6:29 and 6:36.
